id.description: The unique Firebase Auth user ID

authProvider.description: Auth provider e.g. google.com or password

isNewUser.description: Flag indicating if this is a newly registered user or returning user

loginCount.description: Number of times user has signed in

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user account was first created

lastLoginAt.description: ISO timestamp of most recent login

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp when data was last updated

stats.description: Complete persistent Noor Islamic user stats, streaks, bookmarks, XP, and settings
